page.subtitle: Scan the cloned repo to surface house-rules — each backed by evidence you can turn into a Skill.

empty.title: No conventions extracted yet
empty.body: Scan the repo to surface house-rules — naming, error handling, structure — each backed by evidence you can turn into a Skill.

noneFound.title: No new conventions found
noneFound.body: The last scan found nothing new. Rules you already accepted or rejected are never proposed again.

codes.not_indexed: The repo is not indexed yet. Wait until indexing finishes on the repo page, then run the scan again.
codes.no_readable_files: None of the sampled files could be read from the clone. Re-sync the repo, then run the scan again.
codes.llm_failed: The model call failed. Check the Conventions model and its API key in Settings, then retry.
codes.timeout: The scan took too long and was stopped. Retry, or pick a faster Conventions model in Settings.
codes.interrupted: The previous scan was interrupted (the API restarted). Run it again.

modal.title: Create a skill from conventions
modal.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# convention} other {# conventions}} selected — edit the text before saving. The rest stay available for another skill.
modal.attachFailed: The skill was saved, but the conventions could not be marked as used.
modal.saveFailed: Could not save the skill. Try again.
